provenance.method: exact Z[i] codimension-2 Galois quotient over Q(i, sqrt(2)) on all 1,080 3-qubit stabilizer states

llm.role: we* multi-agent algebraic quotient and exact certificate synthesis

notes: Pairs with the rank-3 upper bound to settle this cell at chi = 3 exactly. Upgraded from reproduced (floating-point margin) to verified (exact: true) via the division-free Z[i] Galois quotient q(s) in Z[i]^6 modulo P_3 = span_{Q(i)}(A_3, B_3), where (1 + sqrt(2))^3 |H>^3 = A_3 + sqrt(2) B_3 in Z[i]^8 + sqrt(2) Z[i]^8. All 1,080 3-qubit stabilizer states are generated in exact Z[i] arithmetic from affine subspaces and Z_4 quadratic phase forms; 0 states lie in P_3, and none of the parallel ray groups in Q(i)^8 / P_3 spans both A_3 and B_3. Positive controls at m=2 (1 exact rank-2 decomposition) and m=3 rank 3 (16 exact decompositions) are verified in the same run.
